service.name: Corporate retreat entertainment in Aspen
service.serviceType: Live music for corporate retreats and incentive events
service.description: Live music for corporate retreats and private celebrations at Aspen venues, solo through quartet, with travel and lodging.

faqs.q: Can the party run outdoors in Aspen?
faqs.a: Yes, until eight in the evening. Outdoor amplified sound at a private event was capped at 80 dBA at the perimeter, between 9am and 8pm, when we checked, with neighbors within 250 feet owed seven days' notice. Evenings move indoors from there, and we confirm the current figures with your venue. Signet Artists books Aspen retreat evenings from Denver.

faqs.q: What do Aspen venues need from the band?
faqs.a: Venues at this level hold vendors to their standards: a certificate of insurance, which comes with the contract, setup on the venue's schedule, and the sound cap and curfew kept as written.

faqs.q: How much space and power does it need?
faqs.a: A duo takes a corner of about 8 by 6 feet and one dedicated 20-amp circuit; a quartet takes about 14 by 10 feet and two. Setup runs 45 to 90 minutes depending on size, and the drive's margin is built into the setup day.
